segment: The V3 layer publication has a fully specified, product-derived shape now: the three source157 manifests declare EXACTLY the serving home's layers[0:179] prefix map, which identifies the transition as a two-part publication

decisive_finding.fact: the three source157 manifests' installed_prefix equals, byte for byte, the serving home's layers[0:179] map (verified equal). The write-file-format-guard manifest carries no installed_prefix at all.
decisive_finding.meaning: the manifests were authored for a transition whose prefix is exactly this home's first 179 layers. The installed V3 composition reached the same content by the native install path, so its prefix differs (its layer 179 is product153-six with re-serialised manifest bytes). The V3 publication is therefore a transition FROM this home's 179-layer state, not from its present 180-layer state.
decisive_finding.consequence: the ordinary update path's prefix check (manifest['installed_prefix'] == the whole installed layer map) cannot bind the four layers against the serving home as it stands today; it binds them against a 179-layer prefix, i.e. against the state in which product153-six is not yet installed

what_that_implies_concretely.option_A: publish product153-six and the four V3 layers together as one ordered bundle, with the product153-six layer first (its own manifest's installed_prefix must then equal this home's layers[0:179] map) and the three source157 layers following with their declared prefixes; the guard layer, which declares no prefix, must be proven separately by its file-level before_sha256 pins (all four of its inputs match the serving home's current bytes exactly).
what_that_implies_concretely.option_B: publish only the four V3 layers against a 179-layer prefix baseline, i.e. after product153-six is rolled out of the prefix - not possible on this home without rewriting history.
what_that_implies_concretely.precedent_for_A: the v44/source90 precedent transaction does exactly this: it binds a multi-layer bundle by (a) an exact project-delta pin, (b) the installed layer count, (c) the canonical overlay order with the already-proven cli-launcher commutation, (d) each layer's manifest bytes/patch bytes/file preimages, and (e) the manifest's own declared installed_prefix equal to the running prefix map
what_that_implies_concretely.pins_already_available: product153-six's manifest is in the repository with its own installed_prefix; the four V3 manifests and patches are in the repository; the 184-layer input already targets this home; the serving home's live pins (marker, receipt, stamp, config, profile, launcher, credentials, unit) and its exact transaction-history map are all readable

verification_already_done: the four V3 patches apply cleanly to this home's source files in order and every resulting digest equals the installed V3 composition's receipt entry
the serving home's layer map, marker and ordinary check are consistent today
the 179-entry prefix map of the three source157 manifests equals this home's layers[0:179] exactly

next_executable_step.action: build the frozen candidate for the V3 transition: one ordered bundle of product153-six plus the three source157 layers with their declared prefixes, and the guard layer proven by file preimages; pin the project inventory (the 184-layer input), the native root and the input; write the request with this home's live pins, the committed successor as predecessor and the exact history map; run it with the gateway stopped, then verify receipt 180 -> 185 layers, composition_checked, the ordinary check, restart the single gateway and confirm both user profiles
